title.zh-TW: 首次購買滿 NT$399，輸入優惠碼折 NT$50
title.en: NT$50 off a first order of NT$399 or more

text.zh-TW: 限第一筆訂單、單筆滿 NT$399，結帳時輸入好友優惠碼 MGMBJJUG4。活動期間 2026/10/07 至 11/03，限 2026/10/07 之前沒有寶雅線上買消費紀錄的會員。取自平台分享文案與官方活動公告；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Friend promo code MGMBJJUG4. Runs 2026/10/07 to 11/03; no POYA online purchase before 10/07. From the share text and official notice; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（會前往 POYA寶雅線上買的邀請頁面）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (it leads to the POYA online shop invitation page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示加入或登入 POYA寶雅線上買會員。
steps.en: Join or sign in to your POYA online shop membership as the page asks.

steps.zh-TW: 首次購物且單筆訂單滿 NT$399，結帳時輸入好友優惠碼 MGMBJJUG4；若連結已帶入，請確認代碼相同。
steps.en: On a first order of NT$399 or more, enter friend promo code MGMBJJUG4 at checkout; if it is already filled in, check that it matches.

steps.zh-TW: 確認結帳金額已折抵 NT$50，使用條件以官方活動公告為準。
steps.en: Check that NT$50 is deducted at checkout; conditions follow the official campaign notice.

intro.zh-TW: POYA寶雅線上買首購滿 NT$399，結帳輸入好友優惠碼 MGMBJJUG4 可折抵 NT$50。
intro.en: First order of NT$399+ at POYA online shop: enter code MGMBJJUG4 at checkout for NT$50 off.

description.zh-TW:
寶雅（POYA）是台灣的美妝、個人護理與生活用品零售品牌，POYA寶雅線上買是它的線上購物商店。這個邀請連結適用於首次購買：訂單滿 NT$399，結帳時輸入好友優惠碼 MGMBJJUG4，可折抵 NT$50。優惠碼已包含在連結的參數中；若結帳時沒有自動帶入，請依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入。

依 POYA 官方活動公告，邀請好友活動的期間為 2026/10/07 至 11/03，限 2026/10/07 之前沒有寶雅線上買消費紀錄的會員參加，每位新朋友只能接受 1 位好友的優惠碼，折價券限用於第一筆訂單。實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en:
POYA is a Taiwanese retail brand for beauty, personal care and lifestyle products, and POYA寶雅線上買 (the POYA online shop) is its online store. This referral link is for a first purchase: on an order of NT$399 or more, enter the friend promo code MGMBJJUG4 at checkout to get NT$50 off. The code is already part of the link's parameters; if it is not filled in at checkout, enter it manually, exactly as shown, including capitalization.

According to POYA's official campaign notice, the invite-a-friend campaign runs from 2026/10/07 to 11/03. It is open to members with no online-shop purchase before 2026/10/07, each new friend can accept only one friend code, and the coupon applies to the first order only. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow POYA's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
優惠碼 MGMBJJUG4 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫）。限首次購買的新朋友：2026/10/07 之前沒有寶雅線上買消費紀錄，且只能接受 1 位好友的優惠碼，折價券限用於第一筆訂單、單筆滿 NT$399。官方活動公告的活動期間為 2026/10/07 至 11/03，結束後優惠可能調整或終止。分享文案寫「現折 NT$50」；官方公告一處寫好友專屬優惠碼現折 $50，另一處寫輸入好友專屬優惠碼後再加碼 $50 折價券，限用於第一筆訂單、單筆滿 $399 折抵。實際折抵方式與其他使用規範，以結帳畫面與券面說明為準。主辦單位保有解釋、修改及終止活動的權利，請以官方公告為準。

依邀請頁，首張訂單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠。poyabuy.com.tw 是 POYA寶雅線上買的購物網域；POYA 官網（poya.com.tw）的活動公告連結到它，分享連結也由此網域產生。
notes.en:
Promo code MGMBJJUG4 is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. The offer is for new friends making a first purchase: no POYA online shop purchase record before 2026/10/07, only one friend code per new friend, and the coupon applies to the first order only, on a single order of NT$399 or more. The official campaign notice sets the period at 2026/10/07 to 11/03, and the offer may change or end afterwards. The share text says NT$50 off immediately (現折). The official notice words it two ways: NT$50 off with the friend promo code in one place, and an extra NT$50 coupon after the friend promo code is entered, valid on the first order only and on a single order of NT$399 or more, in another. How the amount is applied, and any further usage rules, follow the checkout page and the coupon terms. POYA reserves the right to interpret, change or end the campaign; the official announcements prevail.

Per the invitation page, if the first order is cancelled or returned, later orders get no offer. poyabuy.com.tw is the domain of the POYA online shop; the campaign notice on POYA’s own site (poya.com.tw) links to it, and the share link is generated on it.

q.zh-TW: 好友優惠碼要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the friend promo code?

a.zh-TW: 在 POYA寶雅線上買的結帳時輸入好友優惠碼 MGMBJJUG4。本頁的邀請連結已帶有這組代碼；若結帳時沒有自動帶入，請依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入。
a.en: Enter friend promo code MGMBJJUG4 at checkout in the POYA online shop. The invite link on this page already carries the code; if it is not filled in at checkout, type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization.

a.zh-TW: 依 POYA 官方活動公告，限 2026/10/07 之前沒有寶雅線上買消費紀錄的會員。每位新朋友只能接受 1 位好友的優惠碼，折價券限用於第一筆訂單，且單筆訂單需滿 NT$399。活動期間為 2026/10/07 至 11/03。
a.en: According to POYA's official campaign notice, it is limited to members with no purchase record in the POYA online shop before 2026/10/07. Each new friend can accept only one friend code, the coupon applies to the first order only, and a single order must reach NT$399. The campaign runs from 2026/10/07 to 11/03.
